description.en: Original stylized Bobasatrania whole-organism living reconstruction, anchored to the upper B. canadensis example in BCGS Plate 1-7-3. Unpreserved depth, palette and fine anatomy are artistic.
description.zh: 原创低多边形 Bobasatrania 全身活体重建；体厚、配色和精细解剖为艺术选择。

reconstruction_uncertainties: All depth, color, exact jaw structure, eye/gill shape, membrane thickness and paired-fin insertion are artistic. No measured all-angle or species-perfect claim.
author: Leon Made This / s010s
acceptance_scope: Original frozen scoped independent model review with retained advisories; no blanket formal/GPU/neighbor/reproducibility or user visual approval. Website image review remains separate.
scale_scope: Nominal authored display dimensions; not new specimen metrology.
